scenarios.title: A battle enters with defense counters equal to its printed defense
decisions: A casts Invasion of Gobakhan, tapping two Plains.
B passes priority; Invasion of Gobakhan resolves.
As it enters, A chooses B as its protector.
Its enters trigger targets B; A looks at B's hand and chooses to exile no card.

variants.label: resolves
variants.expected: Invasion of Gobakhan enters the battlefield with 3 defense counters, its printed defense, and B protects it.

variants.label: countered
variants.delta: B responds with Counterspell, tapping two Islands.
variants.expected: Invasion of Gobakhan is countered and moves to A's graveyard; it never enters the battlefield, so no defense counters are placed.
